claim_checks.detail: Abstract is faithful: continuous-time Markov model observed at discrete waves, generalized-linear/missing-data perspective, estimation methods, coevolution and model comparisons.

claim_checks.claim: Core network state, rates, opportunities, permitted options, choice distribution and objective effects
claim_checks.detail: Fixed directed actor network, no self-ties, single outgoing tie change at an actor opportunity, exponential total waiting time and rate-weighted actor selection, Keep/toggle alternatives, softmax choice and example structural effects are source-supported. Custom rate statistics/effects are explicitly application-specific.

Pseudocode represents the same CTMC event: derive rates from the current state, sample an exponential waiting time, stop at the wave boundary or choose actor and admissible next network state and apply it. Its clock assignment is placed before actor/choice sampling whereas the printed algorithm assigns time after sampling the next state; this is an equivalent event ordering for this time-homogeneous event calculation, and no within-event side effect is asserted. The note uses >= at the boundary while the source says >; equality has probability zero for the continuous exponential wait and does not alter the transition law.

Hamming/rate statistics, structural and objective-effect moments, RSiena three phases, generalized moments and data-augmentation likelihood are correctly scoped. Coevolution statement captures alternating network/behavior opportunities with ordinal behavior ±1 changes; cross-dependence represents selection and influence.

Three waves; 160 participants with 129 present at all waves; up to six nominated friends; outdegree constraint of six; negative distance and indegree effects and positive reciprocity, GWESP and same-gender effects match source. It appropriately frames values as application results rather than defaults.
